definitions.explanation: The skill or activity of making, repairing, or decorating things with a needle and thread.

examples.english: My mother is good at sewing.

{裁縫|さいほう}⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please lend me your sewing tools.

notes:
{裁縫|さいほう} refers to the craft of sewing—making, repairing, or altering clothes and fabric items.
